Hi Asako!
Happy Friday! How was your day? I hope you can now get some rest after the busy week.
Asako, please thank Mr. Koga on my behalf for being so generous! This is very very kind of him to do this...
And, of course, I will have Thursday evening free for the dinner. This would be a great privilege for me to
join you and Mr. Koga.
Thank you for asking about the tea ceremony. It was truly a remarkable experience and I feel so fortunate to
have being able to participate...I would love to share more about it with you on Sunday!
And about Sunday, thank you again for agreeing to spend time with me, I really appreciate it. Either plan
sounds great to me, which one would be best for you?
Thank you so much!
Karyna

EFTA00566241

 Happy Friday Karyna!
How was Kaiseki and tea ceremony experience?
I can't wait to learn all about it on Sunday!
Karyna, please save your Thursday evening (Feb 16) to have dinner with Mr. Koga.
We will meet you at the hotel lobby at 1830 and will leave together. Dinner is at 19:00.
He will take us to a very special restaurant where he only takes top end visitors from overseas and top Japanese
businessmen or politicians!
You will love the experience for sure!!
Karyna, for Sunday, would you like to meet after lunch or we meet a bit before lunch say 11am and we can do lunch
together?
There is my favorite Soba place nearby Meiji Shrine and thought you might like it there or we can have an early dinner
there after Asakusa/Kappabashi.
http://matsubara-an.com/shops/keyaki.php

Plan A:
Meet at the hotel at 1300, visit Meiji Shrine to Asakusa (takes about 30 minute subway ride b/w Omotesando to Asakusa)
to Kappabashi back to Omoteando area for Soba dinner
Or
Plan B:
Meet at the hotel at 1100, have soba lunch to Meiji Shrine (a matter of 5 minute or less walk) to Asakusa to Kappabashi to
if you would like, I can show you the neighborhood where I live and have a quick dinner at typical Japanese causal
restaurant.
https://tabelog.com/tokyo/A1318/A131802/13001424/dtlphotolst/4/smp/Z
or anywhere else you would like to visit, please feel free to let me know!
Karyna, I have copied my personal mobile email address and would appreciate it if you could keep it when reply.
Thank you!!
Asako
